question: In October 2021, which Union Territory gave a financial nod to the e-health card project, conceived as a repository to store an individual’s entire medical history, which will be connected to a cloud-based health information management system?
solution:
The correct answer is **Delhi.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Health Information Management System**

 
 
• The Ministry of **Health & Family Welfare** (MoHFW) developed the web-based Government to Government (G2G) Monitoring Information System known as the Health Management Information System **(HMIS).**
 
• India's government will keep an eye on the **National Health Mission** and other health programs and provide important information for developing policies and implementing programs that are right.
 
• HMIS was launched in **October 2008.**
 
• On the HMIS web portal, approximately **2 lakh health facilities **in all States and UTs are currently uploading facility-specific service **delivery data** monthly, **training data** quarterly, and **infrastructure-related data** annually.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **e-health Card**

 
 
• The proposed e-health card system aims to boost service **efficiency, accessibility, and accountability.**
 
• The** research, design,** and **implementation** of an e-health card-based solution that can integrate and coordinate with heterogeneous IT environments are presented in this project.
 
 
 
• **Advantages of health card**
 
 
• Patients **save money** on their medical bills.
 
• The benefits card is** valid for life.**
 
• The patient's data are **stored **on this card. 
 
 
 
• **Disadvantages of health card**
 
 
• An** active internet connection** is required for this application.
 
• The user must enter **accurate data**, or it will behave abnormally.
